segments.name: FRP products
segments.description: Manufactures fiberglass reinforced plastic tanks, pipes, ducts and custom products for chemical processing, water treatment and power generation industries.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it operates as a single operating and reportable segment in accordance with ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for FRP products and related installation and maintenance services, plus warranties, technical services and transportation.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from the sale of our FRP products and related installation and maintenance services.

changes.text: The majority-owned subsidiary RBSB ceased its business operations in 2026.
changes.evidence: Subsequent to December 31, 2025, we became aware that RBSB, a majority-owned subsidiary, ceased its business operations effective from January 15, 2026.
